# List of international presidential trips made by Chandrika Kumaratunga

This is a list of international presidential trips made by Chandrika Kumaratunga, who served as the 5th President of Sri Lanka 12 November 1994 to 19 November 2005. Note this list may not be complete.
Summary of international trips
According to this list Chandrika Kumaratunga made 45 foreign trips to 25 countries.
